features.note: 3 blade slabs at even ~0.133 m pitch; middle blade shows its bright top face while top/bottom blades show dark faces tilted the opposite way — counter-rotation reads correctly. Docked one notch: UI shows APERTURA 2% while blades sit at ~25 deg, so the near-closed state is not what the capture shows.

Orange body hangs offset from the frame (not flush) below the shaft line, with a black clamp block and a gray stub protruding from the frame right face — the mounting concept is right. But only ~1 voxel of free spindle reads between frame face and clamp (spec demands visible >=37 mm), and no anti-rotation strap is readable bridging actuator to frame; the dark cubes nearby read as cable, not strap.

White pointer block present at the shaft/clamp position on top of the actuator — correct location at blockout granularity. Printed 0-90 arc absent (materials-pass item, not penalized here); 1:1 rotation unverifiable from a still.
Channel casing shows real depth (~0.13 m vs 0.60 face width) and two parallel flange rings read on both faces (front ring plus rear rail visible at top). Proportions match 600x400x127.

Exposed dark vertical tie-rod bar on the left (non-actuator) side spanning the three blade axle heights, with light crank nubs at the pivots. Present and plausibly connected; coherent motion unverifiable from a still.

important_features.note: Dark strips read along the blade long edges / meeting lines (matches 'sellos' legend color). Jamb seals at the frame sides not clearly visible. Threshold shown is the GATES important-average bar, not a spec per-item threshold.
No label placeholder visible on the actuator face. CanvasTexture text is a materials-pass item, but a light rectangular slab placeholder should exist by then; absent at blockout.
Stepped dark voxel cubes descend and curve away from the actuator gland area — reads as a drooping cable, not a straight rod. Good blockout of the catenary.

defects: No anti-rotation strap reads between the actuator body and the frame right face — the spec's actuator-on-shaft feature explicitly includes it; the dark cubes in that region read as cable only.
Free spindle between frame face and U-clamp reads ~1 voxel (~20 mm); spec requires a visible >=37 mm free spindle before the clamp.
State incoherence: UI slider shows APERTURA 2% but blades sit at ~25 deg tilt — the capture does not show the near-closed state its own HUD claims.
No placeholder for the printed 0-90 indicator arc at the pointer pivot (acceptable at blockout, must appear by the materials pass).
Nameplate placeholder absent and jamb seals not visible at frame sides — important_features average lands at 0.60, below the 0.65 bar.
corrections: Add the anti-rotation strap: a thin dark slotted slab bridging the actuator lower body to the frame right face near local [0.31, -0.14, 0], surface-contact, visually distinct from the cable.
Extend the exposed drive-shaft stub so at least 2 voxels (>=40 mm) of free plated spindle read between the frame right face and the U-clamp; keep the clamp a distinct black block around the stub tip.
Make the blade angle match the APERTURA readout in the capture: either capture at slider ~25-30 to match the current tilt, or drive blade rotation from the slider so 2% shows blades nearly seated.
Add a flat light disc/quad placeholder at the indicator pointer pivot (future 0-90 printed arc) and a small light rectangular slab on the actuator face as nameplate placeholder.
Add thin dark jamb-seal strips along the left/right interior faces of the frame opening.
